reviews.comment: This guy cracked me up. He genuinely is a good teacher and was fair on each exam. The partial credit was even better. But he does not really seem to care to teach really and it was funny compared to other 363 classes we were learned completely different things. We only did EOM's and never any vibrations. I really liked him though

Fall 2024 Review: You will cover the basics and end the course with deriving equations of motion. As a professor, he explains things clearly and tests you fairly (on material you learned in some way). However, you need to pay attention in class because his notes mostly consist of what he actually writes in the lecture (examples, key understanding).
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Does not try very hard to explain things and break down complex topics. When you ask him how he got to a certain answer he is very condescending. Do not recommend

Dr. Rathinam's lectures are very good. Be prepared to read before class as they tend to be advanced. Tests aren't straight forward but if you work enough, you should be able to score decently. Not an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs. Homework and tests are graded HARD and do not match up with his lectures. Would be worth delaying graduation to take this course with someone else in a later semester, because you will likely end up failing his class and taking it again later anyway

He does not have a clear concept of what material he's been teaching in class so his homework does not stay consistent with the lecture material. Even though he's accessible outside class but the test and grading overall is hard
